skill_name: Describe how a smartphone works in up to 5 sentences.
workflow: A smartphone is a handheld device that combines the features of a cellular phone with computing capabilities. It has a main processor, memory, and an operating system, along with integrated sensors and wireless capability. Smartphones also have a variety of hardware components, including a display screen, a microphone, speakers, buttons, cameras, a GPS receiver, and a battery.
